description: The plot illustrates the relationship between sample token count and shared experts for two samples. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>9</sup> to 2<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 2<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples” and has a linear scale, ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A red line, representing “Intent”, begins at approximately 5.2 at 2<sup>9</sup> and ends at approximately 5.6 at 2<sup>20</sup>, with a slight decline between 2<sup>11</sup> and 2<sup>12</sup>, dropping from 5.3 to 4.9. A blue line, representing “Summary”, starts at 3.0 at 2<sup>9</sup> and increases to 5.8 at 2<sup>20</sup>, with a peak at 2<sup>17</sup>, reaching a value of 5.8. An orange line, representing “Law”, begins at 4.5 at 2<sup>9</sup> and ends at approximately 5.5 at 2<sup>20</sup>, with a peak at 2<sup>14</sup>, reaching a value of 5.2. A purple line, representing “Translation”, starts at 3.8 at 2<sup>9</sup> and ends at approximately 5.3 at 2<sup>20</sup>, with a peak at 2<sup>16</sup>, reaching a value of 5.3. A green line, representing “Math”, begins at 3.5 at 2<sup>9</sup> and ends at approximately 5.4 at 2<sup>20</sup>, with a peak at 2<sup>15</sup>, reaching a value of 5.3.
